bounded-snapshot.statement: A dedicated read-only SQLite snapshot exposes consistent caller-owned scans with shared native/decoded-result budgets, explicit early stop and cleanup on every exit; unsupported remote routes do not execute or fall back.
bounded-snapshot.falsifier: A concurrent write changes the observed snapshot, a mutation succeeds, exhausted results appear complete, cleanup leaves a transaction/callback active, or remote capability invokes an unimplemented operation.
